events.text: Herod the Great rules for Rome and rebuilds the temple.
Jesus is crucified and rises (about AD 30).
The church spreads from Jerusalem across the empire.
Revolt against Rome from AD 66; the temple destroyed in AD 70.
Nero is emperor from AD 54; fire destroys much of Rome in AD 64, and Christians are blamed and persecuted.
A year of civil war, then Vespasian.
Written from prison, perhaps AD 64 to 67 (if by Paul), as Paul expects to die

teaser.title: Paul is first jailed in Rome
teaser.text: Acts ends with Paul under house arrest in Rome, about AD 60 to 62.

teaser.title: 2 Timothy is written
teaser.text: From prison again, Paul writes his last letter (if by Paul).

teaser.title: Paul's death
teaser.text: Church tradition says Paul was put to death in Rome under Nero.
